summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-23) 发现 10 个 Commit 信号，17 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 服务器动态管理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 允许用户在运行时动态启用或禁用 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 服务器，极大地增强了 AI 工具链的灵活性和可控性，无需重启即可切换工具环境。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 配置发现机制
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 引入 `/agents config` 命令和改进的发现机制，解决了多 Agent 环境下的配置管理痛点，使得 Agent 的选择和配置更加直观和自动化。

engineering_signals.title: 会话历史预加载优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 在 WebSocket 连接建立前预加载会话历史，显著减少了用户等待时间，消除了建立连接后的空白期，极大提升了多轮对话的流畅度和用户体验。

engineering_signals.title: 大文本粘贴占位符
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 通过将大文本替换为占位符（如 [Pasted Text: X lines]），大幅减少了 Token 消耗并提高了上下文处理效率，同时防止了上下文窗口溢出。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 技能动态加载
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 实现了从 Agent 服务器动态加载技能，这意味着 Agent 的能力集可以在运行时扩展，无需重新部署核心服务，增强了系统的可扩展性。

engineering_signals.title: 上下文输出截断优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 针对 Read 和 Bash 工具实现了按比例输出截断，防止长输出阻塞上下文窗口，确保 Agent 在处理大文件或长日志时不会因 Token 限制而失效。

engineering_signals.title: 线程隔离上下文修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了上下文未使用线程本地隔离的严重并发安全问题，防止了多线程环境下的数据竞争和状态污染，对于高并发 AI 应用至关重要。

engineering_signals.title: 条件规则引擎
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 引入条件规则功能，允许 Agent 根据特定条件动态调整行为，使得 AI 的控制逻辑更加精细化和场景化，超越了静态指令的限制。

engineering_signals.title: Hook 注入上下文安全化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 将 Hook 注入的上下文包裹在独特的 XML 标签中，防止了提示注入攻击和数据混淆，增强了通过 Hooks 扩展功能时的安全性。

engineering_signals.title: Zed 用户自定义斜杠命令
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 允许用户在 Zed 编辑器中定义自定义斜杠命令，提升了编辑器与 AI 交互的可定制性，允许开发者封装特定的工作流。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

key_changes: 统一配置接口：所有提示通过 prompt 输入，CLI 选项通过 claude_args 配置
自动模式检测：智能判断交互模式或自动化模式，无需手动配置
完整 CLI 能力支持：通过 claude_args 直接访问所有 Claude Code CLI 功能
多项输入参数废弃：mode、direct_prompt、custom_instructions 等被替换
增强云平台兼容性：改进与 AWS Bedrock 和 Google Vertex AI 的集成
ai_summary.summary_cn: Claude Code GitHub Action 发布 v1.0 正式版，这是一个包含破坏性变更的主版本升级。新版本简化了配置流程，统一了 prompt 和 CLI 参数接口，并新增自动模式检测和完整 CLI 能力支持。从 v0.x 升级需要参考迁移指南调整已废弃的配置项。

releases.author: kausmeows
releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Azure Blob Storage:** Knowledge now supports private Azure Blob Storage for file loading, similarly to Sharepoint and Github.
- **OpenAI Responses API:** Add support for the OpenAI Responses API specification for providers that implement it (Ollama v0.13.3+, OpenRouter beta).

## Bug Fixes:

- **LightRAG search:** Fix added to preserve references in search response.
- **MilvusDB**: Specify `output_fields` in document lookup queries to fix Milvus Lite error
- **Async Database Drivers:** Fix table caching in AsyncSQLiteDb, AsyncPostgresDb, AsyncMySQLDb, and FirestoreDb where `None` values were incorrectly cached, preventing table creation on subsequent calls.

## What's Changed
* fix: preserve LightRAG references in search response [SDK-404] by @harshsinha03 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6119
* fix: Milvus Lite query bug and upsert hybrid search handling [SDK-294] by @harshsinha03 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6118
* feat: Azure blob storage by @willemcdejongh in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6120
* [feat] add OpenAI Responses API support for Ollama and OpenRouter by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6061
* fix: Remove deprecated Pydantic Config and use `model_config` by @benmezger in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6123
* fix: remove hasattr caching in async db drivers preventing table creation by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6128
* chore: Release 2.4.2 by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6130


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/compare/v2.4.1...v2.4.2

key_changes: 新增 Azure Blob Storage 私有存储支持，扩展文件加载能力
新增 OpenAI Responses API 规范支持（Ollama v0.13.3+ 和 OpenRouter）
修复 LightRAG 搜索中引用丢失的问题
修复多个异步数据库驱动的表创建缓存问题（SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Firestore）
修复 Milvus Lite 查询错误，指定 output_fields 解决文档查找问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: Agno v2.4.2 版本主要增强了云存储和 API 兼容性能力，新增了 Azure Blob Storage 私有存储支持和 OpenAI Responses API 规范支持。同时修复了多个关键 Bug，包括异步数据库驱动的表创建缓存问题、LightRAG 搜索引用丢失问题以及 Milvus Lite 查询错误，提升了系统稳定性和兼容性。

key_changes: 回滚路径特殊字符处理和快照读取逻辑的变更
桌面端新增巴西葡萄牙语和挪威语翻译支持
添加多项桌面端烟雾测试（终端、文件查看器、模型选择器等）

Core: 修复 cat 命令权限检查，为 Venice 提供商添加提示缓存支持
ai_summary.summary_cn: v1.1.32 版本主要包含大量修复和改进，其中最重要的是回滚了之前关于路径特殊字符和快照读取的变更。桌面端进行了大量改进，包括新增巴西葡萄牙语和挪威语翻译支持、修复多个 UI 问题（Windows 路径处理、会话按钮、悬停卡片等），并添加了全面的烟雾测试套件。Core 方面修复了 cat 命令权限检查、MCP stderr 日志输出等问题，并为 Venice 提供商添加了提示缓存支持。

key_changes: 修复了终端工具动作的工具调用权限默认值的回归问题
解决了部分终端工具操作的权限默认设置错误
确保工具调用权限的默认行为符合预期
ai_summary.summary_cn: 这是一个修复版本，主要解决了 v0.220.3 中引入的回归问题，该问题导致某些终端工具动作的工具调用权限默认值出现异常。本次更新修复了权限默认设置，确保终端工具的操作行为恢复正常。
